nondimensionalization.comment: sigma = mu = R0 = 1, so Ca_in is the mean inlet speed and La = rho

physics.bubble_volume: 4/3 pi R0^3, held fixed; the void pressure is its Lagrange multiplier
physics.pad_comment: liquid length behind and ahead of the bubble, in tube radii; the window parameter, established by verification/s5_window.py rather than assumed

boundaries.inlet: Poiseuille of mean Ca_in, shifted by -U
boundaries.outlet_comment: Poiseuille at both ends is the exact infinite-tube condition; 'traction_free' reproduces the parent Basilisk outlet and carries a fixed absolute pressure deficit of 0.066 (measured, verification/s0_poiseuille.py)
boundaries.wall: no slip in the laboratory frame, hence -U in the bubble frame

closure.comment: the void axial first moment is held fixed, removing the translational null mode; 'tip' pins the rear tip instead

solve.comment: a confined bubble has no static equilibrium, so a short transient relaxation precedes the stationary polish; see VoidBubbleProblem.solve_to_steady
